title: Real-time LLM Inference on Standard GPUs: 3k tokens/s per request
summary: A technical blog post demonstrating how to achieve 3,000 tokens/s inference throughput per request for large language models using standard consumer GPUs, likely through optimizations like dynamic batching, quantization, and efficient memory management.
problem_solved: Enables real-time conversational AI responses on affordable, standard hardware instead of requiring expensive specialized AI accelerators.
why_valuable: democratizes real-time AI deployment by reducing infrastructure costs and making high-performance LLM inference accessible to smaller teams and startups.
